title: This Temple Is Older Than Its City — Guangzhou Heritage Day P1 光孝寺 | China Travel Expert
description:
A temple older than the city around it. In Guangzhou they say: "未有羊城，先有光孝" — first Guangxiao, then Guangzhou.

This is Stop 1 of my Guangzhou Heritage Day route. Guangxiao Temple has roughly 1,700 years of history — the site was a princely residence before it was ever a temple. It's where Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of Chan (Zen) Buddhism, was ordained; the Tang-dynasty Hair-Burial Pagoda (瘗发塔) marks where his hair was buried. Come at dawn, before the tour buses, then walk the route stop by stop.

🧭 Expert Tip: Enter right at opening — the bodhi-tree courtyard is empty and the morning light is at its best for photos and for standing still.

未有羊城，先有光孝——比广州还老的一座寺。
